title: Follow Through
description: Thân di chuyển rồi dừng, chiếc ăng-ten năm đốt trên đỉnh nghiêng trễ theo, vượt qua rồi lắc nhẹ mới yên.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio follow-through, written here): A 40 px body moves x 0 → 180 px in 880 ms power2.inOut and stops; a 5-segment chain (10 px each) stands up from its top centre. Each segment leans 0.04 rad per px of lag (its own spring-tracked x, stiffness 240 / (1 + 0.8 i), damping ratio 0.26, minus the body x), limited to ±66°: the tip lags ~24 px, overshoots ~11 px after the stop and settles by ~90 % of the cycle. Returns the same way. Params: segments (5 × 10 px) · stiffness (240) · damping ratio (0.26) · limit (±66°). Each segment tracks the body on its own spring; the lean follows the lag, so the tip trails, overshoots after the stop and settles.
